'''Kibi no Homuchi no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (''kibi no homuchi no kuni no miyatsuko'', ''kibi no homuchi kokuzō'') was a {{ill|kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造}} who ruled [[#Territory|Homuchi Province]].

== Overview ==

=== Ancestry ===
*According to the "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}'', '''{{ill|Ōfunatari-no-Sukune|ja|大船足尼}}''', a third-generation descendant of {{ill|Wakatsunoki-no-Mikoto|ja|若角城命}}, was appointed kuni no miyatsuko during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ja|成務天皇|lt=Emperor Seimu}}.

=== Clan ===
'''{{ill|Kibi-no-Homujibe clan|ja|吉備品遅部氏}}''' (''kibi no homujibe-uji''; {{ill|kabane|ja|カバネ|lt=kabane}} of {{ill|Kimi (kabane)|ja|キミ (カバネ)|lt=Kimi}}).

== Base ==

=== Territory ===
The kuni no miyatsuko's territory was the region then known as '''Homuchi Province''', corresponding to the later {{ill|Homuchi District|ja|品治郡}} of {{ill|Bingo Province|ja|備後国}} — present-day part of {{ill|Fukuyama|ja|福山市|lt=Fukuyama City}}, {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|ja|広島県}}.
